{{$|0.90}}/pizza | previous = [[Ham]] | next = [[Shrimp]] }} '''Basil''' is a [[:Category:Vegetables|Veggie]] [[Ingredients|ingredient]] unlocked in [[Chapter 2]]. == Acquisition == Basil becomes available for {{$|125}} in the '''Toppings''' section of the shop on Night 28, one day after meeting the [[Stewards of Sacred Ingredients]]. When you have finished [[Chapter 4]], you will be able to plant Basil in the [[Garden]]. You can buy Basil seeds in the store, which cost {{$|2}} per seed. When you obtain some basil from the Garden, a gauge will appear by the topping bin, showing how much free basil you have. == Pricing == * Costs nothing if harvested Basil is stocked; otherwise, it costs {{$|0.90}} per pizza ({{$|0.05}} a piece). * Sells for {{$|1.20}} per pizza. == Upgrade == The '''Basil Autobuddy''' can be purchased in the [[Upgrades]] section of the shop. The pricing for the upgrades are: * Mobile: {{$|40|PG}} * Steam: {{$|500}} == Topping skins == {| class="article-table" ! Image !! Name !! Initial release !! Also included |- | [[File:Ingredients Skins Shamrock Basil.png|80x60px|center|Shamrock Basil]] || Shamrock Basil || [[St. Patrick's Day Event (2023)]] - '''Leprechaun's Topping Skins''' || [[Bacon]], [[Bell Pepper]] |- | [[File:Ingredients Skins Holly Basil.png|80x60px|center|Holly Basil]] || Holly Basil || [[Winter Festival (2023)]] - '''Frosty Topping Skins''' || [[Pepperoni]], [[Anchovy]] |- |[[File:Ingredients Skins Dino Basil.png|80x60px|center|Dino Basil]] |Dino Basil |Black Friday Sale - '''Jurassic Topping Skins''' |[[Sliced Tomato]], [[Ham]] |- |[[File:Ingredients Skins Headstone Basil.png|80x60px|center|Headstone Basil]] |Headstone Basil |[[Monster Mash (2026)]] - '''Scaredy Topping Skins''' |[[Anchovy]], [[Shrimp]] |} == Related events == * [[Basil Festival]] == Related achievements == {{Related achievements}} == Gallery == {{Navbox ingredients}} [[Category:Vegetables]] [[Category:Green ingredients]] [[Category:Chapter 2 ingredients]] [[fr:Basilic]] [[id:Kemangi]]

{{Needs image}} {{Ingredient | title = Eggplant | image = Ingredients Eggplant.png|Default Ingredients Skins Egg-Phantom.png|Skin 1 Ingredients Skins Pansy Eggplant.png|Skin 2 Ingredients Skins Alien Eggplant.png|Skin 3 Ingredients Skins Eggplant Unicorn.png|Skin 4 Recipe Eggplant Halloween.png|Halloween 1 Ingredients Skins Eggplant Mirrors.png|Halloween 2 Ingredients Eggplant-Box.png|Box Recipe Eggplant.png|Recipe | name = Eggplant | other_names = *Egg *Large purple tomato things | type = Fruit | unlocked = [[Chapter 1]] | cost_to_unlock = Free | value = {{$|1.30}}/pizza | cost = Free (via plant pot/gardening)
{{$|1.26}}/pizza | previous = [[Mushroom]] | next = [[Olive]] }} '''Eggplant''' is a [[:Category:Fruits|Fruit]] [[Ingredients|ingredient]] unlocked in [[Chapter 1]] as a gift from a [[Plant Lady|special customer]]. It is the fourth topping available in the game. When ordering, customers may use egg puns, mention breakfast, or refer to them as "large purple tomato things." ==Acquisition== On Day 4, Plant Lady will visit the pizzeria offering a special gift in exchange for a free pizza. Make her any pizza and she will give a potted plant in return that will be placed on the front counter of the pizzeria. You will be tasked with watering the plant daily until it's ready to harvest, at which point she will return on Day 8 and request an eggplant pizza. Eggplant can then be unlocked for free on Night 8 in the '''Toppings''' section of the shop. ==Pricing== * Costs nothing if harvested Eggplant is stocked; otherwise, it costs {{$|1.26}} per pizza ({{$|0.07}} a piece). * Sells for {{$|1.30}} per pizza. == Upgrade == The '''Eggplant Autobuddy''' can be purchased in the [[Upgrades]] section of the shop. The pricing for the upgrades are: * Mobile: {{$|40|PG}} * Steam: {{$|500}} == Topping skins == {| class="article-table" ! Image !! Name !! Initial release !! Also included |- | [[File:Ingredients Skins Egg-Phantom.png|80x60px|center|Egg-Phantom]] || Egg-Phantom || [[Monster Mash (2022)]] - '''Halloween Topping Trio''' || [[Mushroom]], [[Onion]] |- | [[File:Ingredients Skins Pansy Eggplant.png|80x60px|center|Pansy Eggplant]] || Pansy Eggplant || [[Floral Appreciation (2024)]] - '''Botanical Topping Skins''' || [[Pepperoni]], [[Onion]] |- | [[File:Ingredients Skins Alien Eggplant.png|80x60px|center|Alien Eggplant]] || Alien Eggplant || [[Women's Day Mini Event (2025)]] - '''Space Topping Skins''' || [[Anchovy]], [[Jalapeno]] |- |[[File:Ingredients Skins Eggplant Unicorn.png|center|65x65px]] |Eggplant Unicorn |[[Little Ovenists Event (2025)]] - '''Fantasy Topping Skins''' |[[Corn]], [[Onion]] |- |[[File:Ingredients Skins Eggplant Mirrors.png|80x60px|center|Eggplant Mirrors]] || Eggplant Mirrors || [[Monster Mash (2025)]] - '''Haunting Topping Skins''' |[[Olive]], [[Pepperoni]] |} ==Gameplay== === Potted version === Eggplant has 6 growth stages, ranging from seedling to harvestable fruit. It must be watered for 5 game days before it's ready to harvest. A water drop icon {{TCI|water}} will be shown to remind players to water their new plant daily. At the end of its growth cycle, the eggplant fruit will be ready to harvest, denoted by a soft glow around the plant and a hand icon {{TCI|harvest}} allowing players to pick the fruit. {| class="article-table" style="text-align: center;" |- ! Stage 1 ! Stage 2 ! Stage 3 ! Stage 4 ! Stage 5 ! Stage 6 |- | scope="col"|[[File:Eggplant Stage-1.png|80x60px|center]]''Seedling'' | scope="col"|[[File:Eggplant Stage-2.png|80x60px|center]]''Sprout'' | scope="col"|[[File:Eggplant Stage-3.png|80x60px|center]]''Vegetative'' | scope="col"|[[File:Eggplant Stage-4.png|80x60px|center]]''Flowering'' | scope="col"|[[File:Eggplant Stage-5.png|80x60px|center]]''Ripening'' | scope="col"|[[File:Eggplant Stage-6.png|80x60px|center]]''Harvestable'' |} Once acquired, Eggplant will be in its own box in the kitchen workspace. It will have a gauge that will steadily deplete showing how much free eggplant is left in stock. If empty, you will have to pay Pizza Funds to use it (see the [[#Pricing|Pricing]] section above for more information). === Garden version === After finishing [[Chapter 4]], you will be able to plant Eggplants in the [[Garden]], which cost {{$|4}} per seed. Eggplants in the garden take 10 hours to fully mature. == Gallery == == Trivia == * Before version 4.0.0, it was the only topping in the game that had to be harvested to replenish its stock and was completely cost-free to you. * Before version 4.1.0, it was not required for variable recipes or recipes that required fruits, and was only necessary on pizzas that specifically asked for it. * In a previous version, it was the only missable topping in the game (if you did not give Plant Lady a pizza, you were unable to buy Eggplant later on). * For players who unlocked Eggplant before version 4.0.0, it is located between [[Basil]] and [[Shrimp]] in the kitchen workspace. {{Navbox ingredients}} [[Category:Fruits]] [[Category:Garden]] [[Category:Chapter 1 ingredients]] [[fr:Aubergine]] [[id:Terong]]

{{$|3.24}}/pizza | previous = [[Chicken]] | next = [[Sliced Tomato]] }} '''Garlic''' is a [[:Category:Vegetables|vegetable]] [[Ingredients|ingredient]] unlocked in [[Chapter 4]]. It is the sixteenth topping available in the game. == Acquisition == Before finishing Chapter 4, Garlic is unlocked when [[Plant Lady]] gives some Garlic Seeds to you. Garlic is initially available for free in Chapter 4 by planting Garlic Seeds in the [[Garden]] for 12 real-life hours. After finishing Chapter 4, it will be available to purchase from the store for {{$|200}}, which gives access to Garlic even if its topping gauge is depleted. This will also make the '''Garlic Buddy''' [[upgrade]] available in the store. == Upgrade == The '''Garlic Autobuddy''' can be purchased in the [[Upgrades]] section of the shop. {{$|2.88}}/pizza | previous = [[Garlic]] | next = [[Jalapeno]] }} '''Sliced Tomato''' is a [[:Category:Fruits|fruit]] [[Ingredients|ingredient]] unlocked in [[Chapter 4]]. It is the seventeenth topping available in the game. == Acquisition == Sliced Tomato is unlocked when [[Plant Lady]] gives you her spare Tomato Seeds. Sliced Tomato is initially available for free in Chapter 4 by planting Tomato Seeds in the [[Garden]] for 10 real-life hours. After finishing Chapter 4, it will be available to purchase from the store for {{$|200}}, which gives access to Sliced Tomato even if its topping gauge is depleted. {{$|3.60}}/pizza | previous = [[Sliced Tomato]] | next = [[Avocado]] }} '''Jalapeno''', sometimes spelled as '''jalapeño''' in the game, is a [[:Category:Fruits|fruit]] [[Ingredients|ingredient]] unlocked in [[Chapter 4]]. It is the eighteenth topping available in the game. == Acquisition == Jalapeno is unlocked after you complete the [[Jack O'Lanter|Farmer]]'s task of harvesting 12 plants in the [[Garden]], obtaining some Jalapeno and its seeds in return. Jalapeno is initially available for free in Chapter 4 by planting Jalapeno Seeds in the Garden for 8 real-life hours. After finishing Chapter 4, it will be available to purchase from the store for {{$|200}}, which gives access to Jalapeno even if its topping gauge is depleted. This will also make the '''Jalapeno Buddy''' [[upgrade]] available in the store. == Upgrade == The '''Jalapeno Autobuddy''' can be purchased in the [[Upgrades]] section of the shop. The pricing for the upgrades are: * Mobile: {{$|40|PG}} * Steam: {{$|500}} == Topping skins == {| class="article-table" ! Image !! Name !! Initial release !! Also included |- | [[File:Ingredients Skins UFO Jalapeno.png|80x60px|center|UFO Jalapeno]] || UFO Jalapeno || [[Women's Day Mini Event (2025)]] - '''Space Topping Skins''' || [[Eggplant]], [[Anchovy]] |- | [[File:Ingredients Skins Charm Jalapeno.png|80x60px|center|UFO Jalapeno]] || Charm Jalapeno || Rare Item Drop - '''Enchanting Topping Skins'''|| [[Artichoke]], [[Ham]] |- | [[File:Ingredients Skins Blooming Jalapeno.png|80x60px|center|Blooming Jalapeno]] |Blooming Jalapeno |[[Made with Love (2026)]] - '''Full Bloom Topping Skins''' |[[Artichoke]], [[Corn]] |- |[[File:Ingredients Skins Frog Jalapeno.png|80x60px|center|Frog Jalapeno]] |Frog Jalapeno |[[Pet Spectacular (2026)]] - '''Pet Topping Skins''' |[[Artichoke]], [[Mushroom]] |} == Related achievements == {{Related achievements}} {{Navbox ingredients}} [[Category:Fruits]] [[Category:Green ingredients]] [[Category:Spicy ingredients]] [[Category:Chapter 4 ingredients]] [[fr:Jalapeño]] [[id:Jalapeno]]

{{Ingredient | title = Avocado | image = <gallery> Ingredients Avocado.png|Single Ingredients Skins Plumeria Avocados.png|Skin 1 Ingredients Skins Lilypad Avocado.png|Skin 2 Ingredients Avocado-Box.png|Box Recipe Avocado.png|Recipe </gallery> | name = Avocado | other_names = *Green fruit that's squishy *Lime wedges *Sea turtles *Soft fruit *Soft green fruit *Surfboard | type = Fruit | type2 = Green | unlocked = Bonfyre Fest ([[Bonfyre Fest (2022)|2022]], [[Bonfyre Fest (2023)|2023]], [[Bonfyre Fest (2024)|2024]], [[Bonfyre Fest (2025)|2025]], [[Bonfyre Fest (2026)|2026]]) | cost_to_unlock = Free | value = {{$|4.50}}/pizza | cost = Free (via [[garden]]ing) | previous = [[Jalapeno]] | next = [[Chili Bean Sauce]] }} '''Avocado''' is a missable [[:Category:Fruits|fruit]] [[Ingredients|ingredient]] that was introduced in the [[Bonfyre Fest (2022)|2022 Summer]] [[event]]. It is the nineteenth topping available in the game.
==Acquisition== Avocado was first mentioned by [[Steve]] in the Bonfyre Fest and then given by [[Plant Lady]] as seeds the day after completing her request during the event. In the [[Bonfyre Fest (2022)|2022 Bonfyre Fest]], Avocado took 15 minutes to grow in the [[Garden]], yielding 18 pieces per plant. However, they now take 6 hours to grow, yielding 50 pieces per plant (60 if you buy the Refined Avocado Seeds upgrade).
Avocado was only available during the 2022 Bonfyre Fest and no longer became available after the event was over. It then became available again in update 4.8.7., though not as seeds. You could only use Avocado until your stock was depleted.
As of version 4.26.0 (mobile; 1.26.0 on Steam), Avocado could become a permanent topping if you finished the [[Bonfyre Fest (2023)|2023 Bonfyre Fest]] event.<ref>[https://twitter.com/goodpizzagame/status/1674468464243646464 GPGP Version 4.26.0 features (Twitter)]</ref> By completing Night 3 (unlocked July 8, 2023), you could obtain an Avocado license, which allows you to grow Avocado all year round and unlock its autobuddy upgrade.
Avocados become available to obtain again in version 5.14.0,<ref>[https://x.com/goodpizzagame/status/1802906611163205660 Bonfyre Fest 2024 requirements (Twitter)]</ref> where you can obtain an Avocado license by collecting 42 stars in the Bonfyre Fest levels if you don't have it yet.
== Upgrade == The '''Avocado Autobuddy''' can be purchased in the [[Upgrades]] section of the shop. The pricing for the upgrades are: * Mobile: {{$|40|PG}} * Steam: {{$|40|PG}}<ref>This is currently the only Steam Autobuddy that cost Pizza Gems instead of Pizza Funds.</ref>
== Topping skins == {| class="article-table" ! Image !! Name !! Initial release !! Also included |- | [[File:Ingredients Skins Plumeria Avocados.png|80x60px|center|Plumeria Avocados]] | Plumeria Avocados | [[Bonfyre Fest (2024)]] - '''Tropical Topping Skins''' | [[Sausage]], [[Mushroom]] |- | [[File:Ingredients Skins Lilypad Avocado.png|80x60px|center|Lilypad Avocado]] | Lilypad Avocado | [[Bonfyre Fest (2026)]] - '''Beach Day Skins''' | [[Mushroom]], [[Shrimp]] |}
==Trivia== *Avocado is the second ingredient in the game to be introduced during a [[Event|limited-time event]], the other being [[Pesto Sauce]].

It is the twenty-first topping available in the game.

== Acquisition == Chili Bean Sauce immediately becomes available in the Grand Pi tournament Day 1. It can only be used in the Grand Pi event mode of the game.

{{Ingredient | title = Truffle | image = Ingredients Truffle.png|Default Ingredients Skins Rose Truffle.png|Skin Ingredients Truffle-Box.png|Box Recipe Truffle.png|Recipe | name = Truffle | type = Fungus | unlocked = *[[Pizza Pass - Season 1]] *[[Pizza Pass - Season 2]] *[[Pizza Pass - Season 3]] | cost_to_unlock = {{$|90}}/300 pieces (before completing the [[Pizza Pass - Season 1|Pizza Pass]] story)
{{$|45}}/300 pieces (after completing the Pizza Pass story)
Free (starting 5.11.0) | value = {{$|5.40}}/pizza | cost = {{$|4.86}}/pizza | previous = [[Tofu]] | next = [[Fig]] }} '''Truffle''' is a [[:Category:Fungi|fungus]] [[Ingredients|ingredient]] introduced in [[Pizza Pass - Season 1]]. It is the second fungus ingredient and the twenty-third topping in the game. == Acquisition == Truffle was first mentioned by [[Veggie Man]] in Season 1 of the Pizza Pass event when it was available and was introduced when [[Plant Lady]] gave some of her friend's Truffles to you. However, you could only start using it from Day 3 of the event. Players who have completed the event are able to use Truffles in their game permanently.[https://twitter.com/goodpizzagame/status/1633553779042967552 GPGP FAQ: "Is Truffle permanent?"] Before completing the Pizza Pass event's story, you could only buy this ingredient in the Shop, costing one {{$|90}} per 300 pieces, and receive additional pieces as you progressed through Pizza Pass. However, it becomes available for half the price after completing the event's story. If you happen to miss Season 1 of Pizza Pass, you can unlock it on [[Pizza Pass - Season 2|Season 2]] in the Pass Shop for {{$|450|PPT2}} and its Autobuddy for {{$|600|PPT2}}.[https://x.com/goodpizzagame/status/1791123176321167822 Additional notes on Pizza Pass S2 (Twitter)] Since the start of [[Pizza Pass - Season 2]], truffle no longer need to be bought in the shop once the meter runs low. You now buy it like most toppings. Truffle and its Autobuddy make another return in the legacy shop of [[Pizza Pass - Season 3]], with the topping costing {{$|450|PPT3}} and its Autobuddy costing {{$|600|PPT3}}. == Topping skins == {| class="article-table" ! Image !! Name !! Initial release |- | [[File:Ingredients Skins Rose Truffle.png|80x60px|center|Rose Truffle]] || Rose Truffle || [[Pizza Pass - Season 1]] - '''Chef Pass''' and '''Master Pass''' |} == References == {{Navbox ingredients}} [[Category:Pizza Pass]] [[Category:Fungi]] [[Category:Missable ingredients]] [[fr:Truffe]]

{{Ingredient | title = Pumpkin | image = <gallery> Ingredients Pumpkin-Box.png|Box Recipe Pumpkin.png|Recipe </gallery> | name = Pumpkin | other_names = | type = Fruit | unlocked = * [[Pumpkin Pizza Palooza]] * Pumpkin Harvest ([[Pumpkin Harvest (2024)|2024]], [[Pumpkin Harvest (2025)|2025]]) | cost_to_unlock = Free | value = {{$|4}}/pizza | cost = {{$|3.60}}/pizza | previous = [[Artichoke]] | next = [[Rose Petal]] }} '''Pumpkin''' is a temporary [[:Category:Fruits|fruit]] [[Ingredients|ingredient]] which is introduced in [[Pumpkin Pizza Palooza]]. It is the twenty-seventh topping in the game.
== Acquisition == Pumpkin was introduced by [[Jack O'Lanter]], who is told by [[Plant Lady]] that you need some pumpkins to sell as a pizza topping. It immediately becomes available for free but only for the duration of the Pumpkin Pizza Palooza event.<ref>[https://twitter.com/goodpizzagame/status/1724225786784432581 Pumpkin Pizza Palooza announcement (Twitter)]</ref> Once the event is over, you can no longer use it as a topping.
Pumpkin returned in [[Pumpkin Harvest (2024)]] and [[Pumpkin Harvest (2025)]], again, as a temporary topping that can only be used during the duration of the event.<ref>[https://x.com/goodpizzagame/status/1850555290061541413 Pumpkin Harvest (2024) sneak peek (Twitter)]</ref>

{{Ingredient | title = Rose Petal | image = <gallery> Ingredients Rose Petal-Box.png|Box Recipe Rose Petal.png|Recipe </gallery> | name = Rose Petal | other_names = | type = Vegetable | unlocked = Valentine's Day Event ([[Valentine's Day Event (2024)|2024]], [[Valentine's Day Event (2024)|2025,2026]]) | cost_to_unlock = Free | value = | cost = | previous = [[Pumpkin]] | next = [[Duck]] }} '''Rose Petal''' is a temporary [[Ingredients|ingredient]] which was introduced in the [[Valentine's Day Event (2024)|2024 Valentine's Day]] [[event]] as the twenty-eighth topping in the game. As roses are parts of a plant which are not fruits, Rose Petals are classified as a [[:Category:Vegetables|vegetable]].
== Acquisition == Rose Petals were introduced by [[Kevin]] in Level 1 of the Wedding Venue mode of the 2024 Valentine's Day event and could only be used in that mode.
Rose Petals returned again on [[Valentine's Day Event (2025)]], and they could still only be used the same way as last year's event. If you made a Rose Petal pizza, its recipe would appear in both your main game and event recipe books. The event recipe book would also show that they are a vegetable.
Rose Petals returned again on [[Valentine's Day Event (2026)]].

{{Ingredient | title = Duck | image = <gallery> Ingredients Duck.png|Default Ingredients Skins Duck Notes.png|Skin Ingredients Duck-Box.png|Box Recipe Duck.png|Recipe </gallery> | name = Duck | type = Meat | unlocked = *[[Pizza Pass - Season 2]] *[[Pizza Pass - Season 3]] | cost_to_unlock = Free | value = {{$|5.40}}/pizza | cost = {{$|4.86}}/pizza | previous = [[Rose Petal]] | next = [[Peach]] }} '''Duck''' is a [[:Category:Meats|meat]] [[Ingredients|ingredient]] introduced in [[Pizza Pass - Season 2]]. It is the eighth meat ingredient and the twenty-ninth topping in the game.
== Acquisition == Duck immediately becomes available once the [[Pizza Pass - Season 2]] event begins, by collecting the initial free reward of the Pizza Pass. Duck becomes temporarily available during the event until you reach level 25 of the Pizza Pass, where you can own the topping permanently. Buying the '''Chef Pass''' or '''Master Pass''' will allow you to unlock it permanently without having to get to level 25. While getting the Autobuddy requires you to get to level 5 of Chef Pass.
Duck and its Autobuddy return again in [[Pizza Pass - Season 3]] with Duck costing {{$|450|PPT3}} and the Autobuddy {{$|600|PPT3}}.

{{Ingredient | title = Peach | image = Ingredients Peach.PNG|Default Ingredients Skins Peach Flower.PNG|Skin Ingredients Peach-Box.png|Box Recipe Peach.png|Recipe | name = Peach | type = Fruit | unlocked = [[Pizza Pass - Season 3]] | cost_to_unlock = Free | value = {{$|5.40}}/pizza | cost = Free (via [[garden]]ing)
{{$|4.86}}/pizza | previous = [[Duck]] | next = [[Apple]] }} '''Peach''' is a [[:Category:Fruits|fruit]] [[Ingredients|ingredient]] introduced in [[Pizza Pass - Season 3]]. It is the thirtieth topping in the game. == Acquisition == Peaches are first introduced at the end of the first in-game day of [[Pizza Pass - Season 3]], where [[Oats]] gives you 100 pieces of it and she will give you another 100 pieces the next in-game day. It immediately becomes available temporarily for free in the Pizza Pass and you can unlock it permanently by reaching level 30 of the Pizza Pass. Buying the '''Chef Pass''' or '''Master Pass''' with real money will allow you to unlock it permanently without having to get to level 30. Its Autobuddy can be bought in the Pass Shop for {{$|600|PPT3}}. == Topping skin == {| class="article-table" ! Image !! Name !! Initial release |- | [[File:Ingredients Skins Peach Flower.PNG|center|80x80px|Peach Flowers]]|| Peach Flowers || [[Pizza Pass - Season 3]] - '''Chef Pass''' and '''Master Pass''' |} == References == {{Navbox ingredients}} [[Category:Pizza Pass]] [[Category:Missable ingredients]] [[Category:Fruits]]

{{Ingredient | title = Apple | image = Ingredients Apple.png|Default Ingredients Skins Apple Rose.png|Skin Ingredients Apple-Box.png|Box Recipe Apple.png|Recipe | type = Fruit | unlocked = [[Pizza Pass - Season 4]] | cost_to_unlock = Free | value = {{$|5.40}}/pizza | cost = Free (via [[garden]]ing)
{{$|4.86}}/pizza | previous = [[Peach]] | next = [[Scallop]] | name = Apple }} '''Apple''' is a [[:Category:Fruits|fruit]] [[Ingredients|ingredient]] introduced in [[Pizza Pass - Season 4]]. It is the thirty-first topping in the game. == Acquisition == Apples are first introduced the night [[Pizza Pass - Season 4]] starts by [[Charlotte Pie]], who decides to share some from her orchard with you, only to forget them. On her visit, the topping becomes available temporarily. She then brings 100 apples the next day, and another 100 the following day. Apples are unlocked permanently once you reach level 30 of Pizza Pass or if you purchase either the '''Chef Pass''' or '''Master Pass'''. Its Autobuddy can be bought in the Pass Shop for {{$|600|PPT4}}. When you permanently unlock them, Charlotte will come to your pizzeria and gives you 100 apples. == Topping skin == {| class="article-table" !Image !Name !Initial release |- | [[File:Ingredients Skins Apple Rose.png|center|80x80px|Apple Rose]] || Apple Rose || [[Pizza Pass - Season 4]] - '''Chef Pass''' and '''Master Pass''' |} {{Navbox ingredients}} [[Category:Fruits]]

{{Ingredient | title = | image = <gallery> Ingredients Scallop.png|Default Ingredients Skins Coral Scallops.png|Skin Ingredients Scallop-Box.png|Box Recipe Scallop.png|Recipe </gallery> | type = Meat | type2 = Seafood | type3 = White | unlocked = [[Pizza Pass - Season 5]] | cost_to_unlock = Free | cost = {{$|4.86}}/pizza | value = {{$|5.40}}/pizza | previous = [[Apple]] | next = }}
'''Scallop''' is a [[:Category:Seafood|seafood]] [[Ingredients|ingredient]] that was introduced in [[Pizza Pass - Season 5]]. It is the thirty-second topping overall and the third seafood topping in the game.
== Acquisition == Scallops are first introduced by [[Pebble]], who visits your pizzeria after being lured over by the smell of pizza. He gives you 100 pieces on his first visit, after which the topping is available temporarily. During the fifth season of Pizza Pass, he will visit you to give you more scallop.
Scallops are permanently unlocked if you reach level 30 of the standard Pizza Pass, or immediately if you buy the '''Chef Pass''' or the '''Master Pass'''. Purchasing either of these premium passes also allows you to unlock the '''Coral Scallops''' skin. Its Autobuddy can be bought in the Pass Shop for {{$|600|PPT5}}, regardless of whether you own the topping permanently.

revision.text:
{{CustomTabs |tab1 = Main |tab2 = Archive }} {{About|order requirements found in dialogue|the recipes listed in the Recipe Book located in the game menu|Recipe Book }} [[File:Recipe_Unknown.png|right|200px]] This page lists order requirements for customers, stories, and recent events. As of update 3.4.9, players can use either Tomato Sauce or Pesto Sauce in orders that do not specify which sauce to use. == Usage notes == === Searching the page === Using "Ctrl + F" and searching for phrases of dialogue will show if the order exists on the page. Alternatively, mobile users can use the "Find on page" option in their phone's browser to search. {| class="mw-collapsible article-table" style="min-width: 100%;" ! colspan="4" | Syntax |- ! Format ! Description ! Example ! Meaning |- | + | Ingredient separator | Sauce + Cheese | Sauce and cheese pizza |- | ( ) + ( ) | Groups ingredients on each half of a pizza | (Sauce) + (Cheese) | Half sauce, half cheese pizza |- | [ ] | Groups ingredients on each pizza if there is more than one pizza | [Sauce]
[Cheese] | One sauce pizza and one cheese pizza |} === Adding to the page === If something is missing or incorrect, please edit the page or leave a comment with the order requirements and related dialogue. {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" style="min-width: 100%;" ! Editing Guidelines |- | # Please check that the recipe is not already listed by searching the page with "Ctrl + F" or your device's equivalent. # When making changes to specific sections of the page, use the "edit section" links, as editing the entire page may cause the source or Visual Editor to lag. # Using the {{t|Order}} template, list ingredients in this order: [[Wheat Dough]] ([[Dough|Regular Dough]] is not specified) - Sauce ([[Tomato Sauce]], [[Pesto Sauce]]) - [[Cheese]] - [[Pepperoni]] - [[Sausage]] - [[Mushroom]] - [[Olive]] - [[Onion]] - [[Bell Pepper]] - [[Bacon]] - [[Pineapple]] - [[Anchovy]] - [[Ham]] - [[Basil]] - [[Eggplant]] - [[Shrimp]] - [[Corn]] - [[Chicken]] - [[Garlic]] - [[Sliced Tomato]] - [[Jalapeno]] - [[Avocado]] - [[Truffle]] - [[Fig]] - [[Zucchini]] - [[Artichoke]] - [[Duck]] - [[Peach]] - [[Apple]] - [[Scallop]]. # Recipes are organized according to the order of the ingredients listed above, with the final ingredient being the section the recipe is listed under (e.g., a cheese pizza with Eggplant, Garlic, and Pepperoni will be listed under "Garlic"). However, there are some exceptions: #* Recipes that use Wheat Dough will be listed under "Wheat Dough," regardless of the toppings used. #* Variable recipes (where ingredients change as new toppings are added to the game) and named recipes (e.g., Vegetarian) will be listed under the "Variable recipe" and "Named recipe" sections, respectively, with the former taking precedence. |} == Gameplay tips == * Unless stated otherwise in the recipes, always use white dough. * Unless the customer asks for a specific slice amount, always cut a pizza into 6 slices. * The perfect topping amount for pizzas is 18. * Make sure to spread out sauce and cheese evenly. * Unless the customer asks for no sauce, always add sauce to the pizza. * Make sure to spread out your toppings. * For half and half pizzas, put the topping only on one side of the pizza. * Put a cooked pizza back into the oven to make it well done. * Asking a customer "What?" will lower their patience. * Be kind to those down on their luck. You can afford to spare a few bucks every now and then, and kindness is often repaid with interest. == Fixed recipes == === Plain Dough === {{Order | None | D1 = I need a pizza with nothing on it. | D1a = Yeah, just crust. | D2 = One flatbread pizza please. | D2a = Nothing on it. | D3 = I'm feeling flatbread. You know, for my minimalist phase. | D3a = Keep it plain with dough. }} {{Order | (Tomato Sauce) + (Pesto Sauce) | D1 = I don't want a plain flatbread. It has to have red and green sauce. But the sauces can't mix together! | D1a = A half pesto and half tomato sauce flatbread! }} === Wheat Dough === {{Order | Wheat Dough | D1 = Hit me with some fiber, champ. | D1a = Just wheat bread. }} {{Order | Wheat Dough + Sauce | D1 = I'm here for the wheat sauce, boss. | D1a = Wheat and sauce, boss. }} {{Order | Wheat Dough + Cheese | D1 = Cheesey wheat bread. | D1a = Just cheese on wheat. | D2 = Wheat and cheese if you please. | D2a = Please, wheat and cheese. }} {{Order | Wheat Dough + Pesto Sauce + (Cheese) | D1 = What's healthier than green sauce on wheat? Half cheese. | D1a = Pesto on wheat dough! Cheese on one side. I'm trying to be healthy. }} {{Order | Wheat Dough + Sauce + Cheese | D1 = I'd like a tuna casserole. No? Well, how about a cheese pizza on wheat? | D1a = Cheese and sauce on wheat dough, please. | D2 = I’m on a wheat diet. | D2a = Wheat pizza, please! }} {{Order | Wheat Dough + Sauce + Cheese + Mushroom | D1 = Woo! I'm so ready for today's game! The only thing missing is a mushroom pizza on wheat. | D1a = I can't focus on the game without pizza! But I'd like mine on wheat dough with sauce, cheese, and mushrooms. }} {{Order | Wheat Dough + (Cheese + Mushroom) + (Sauce + Onion) | D1 = I want a mushion pizza, brown dough. Cheese on the mush side, sauce on the onion side. | D1a = A half mushroom and cheese-half onion and sauce pizza on wheat dough, please. }} {{Order | Wheat Dough + (Sausage) + (Onion) | D1 = I'm sick of society's constraints, man! I want something wild! Gimme a ... wheat pizza... with no sauce, and no cheese, with just onion on one side and sausage on the other! Woo yeah! | D1a = Quit harshin' my chill, man. Half onion, half sausage on wheat. Nothing else. Jeez. }} {{Order | Wheat Dough + Anchovy | D1 = I'd like one field of anchovy. | D1a = Anchovies on wheat. Nothing more. }} {{Order | Wheat Dough + Sauce + Cheese + (Ham) | D1 = Half ham and cheese on wheat. | D1a = The other half is just cheese. }} {{Order | Wheat Dough + Sauce + Cheese + Basil | D1 = I'd like a pizza to help lower my risk of heart disease, type 2 diabetes, obesity, and some forms of cancer... with basil. | D1a = Whole wheat was what I was going for... with basil. }} {{Order | Wheat Dough + Onion + Basil | D1 = Whole grain and onion with basil. | D1a = Onion and basil on whole wheat. No cheese or sauce. }} {{Order | Wheat Dough + Sauce + Cheese + Onion + Basil | D1 = Herb and onion on wheat. | D1a = Herb? Oh. Basil. }} {{Order | Wheat Dough + Sauce + Cheese + Bacon + Basil | D1 = Bake me bacon and basil on whole wheat. | D1a = I want you to top a pizza on whole wheat dough with bacon and basil. Then, bake it in an oven. }} {{Order | Wheat Dough + Corn | D1 = Hey, can you make me some whole grain cornbread? I've just been craving some lately. | D1a = I just want corn on wheat dough, if possible. Sorry, is that weird? | D2 = ALL grain, NO pain! For real, this time. | D2a = Just corn on a wheat dough flatbread, please. }} {{Order | Wheat Dough + Sauce + Cheese + Corn | D1 = I may be going against the grain here, but give me a corn pizza on wheat dough! | D1a = Get it? Because wheat and corn are grains... can I just have my order please? | D2 = I'm training to be a champion pizza-eater. One grainy pizza, please! | D2a = Wheat dough, sauce, cheese, and corn! }} {{Order | [Wheat Dough + Sauce + Cheese + Corn] x3 | D1 = Three pizzas, and I want you to make it grain up in here! | D1a = That would be three cheese pizzas with wheat dough and corn kernels. }} {{Order | Wheat Dough + Sauce + Cheese + Corn + Chicken | D1 = People say flowers are the best way to say sorry, but I think the best way is with a chicken pizza with grains. | D1a = I always forgive people who give me a chicken and corn pizza on wheat dough. }} {{Order | Wheat Dough + Garlic | D1 = Hey, do you guys do whole wheat garlic bread? I just want some of that, thanks! | D1a = I'm sure you could just put garlic cloves on some wheat dough, couldn't you? }} {{Order | [Wheat Dough + Sauce + Cheese + Corn + Garlic] x3 | D1 = I'll take three pies with grains and garlic. | D1a = Wheat dough, sauce, cheese, corn, and garlic. Triple the order! }} {{Order | Wheat Dough + Sauce + Cheese + Chicken + Jalapeno | D1 = Make me a chicken pizza on crispy wheat dough! Add slices of jalapeno, too. I'll need a lot of energy for today! | D1a = Chicken and jalapeno on wheat dough, sauce, and cheese always energize me! Double-baked! WOO! | N1a = Run the pizza through the oven '''twice'''. }} {{Order | Wheat Dough + Sauce + Cheese + (Olive) + (Corn + Truffle) | D1 = Would you be a dear and make me a half corn and truffle and half olive pizza on wheat? | D1a = Half corn and truffle pizza, half olive pizza. Make it with wheat dough. }} {{Order | Wheat Dough + Sauce + Cheese + Fig | D1 = They say the philosopher Chrysippus died from laughter when he saw a donkey eating his figs. Hopefully, a fig pizza on wheat won't do the same to me! | D1a = Just figs, sauce, and cheese, please. On wheat dough. }} {{Order | Wheat Dough + Sauce + Cheese + Chicken + Jalapeno + Fig | D1 = Ever had sweet figs with savory chicken and spicy jalapeno on a cheese pizza with wheat dough? Me neither! I wanna try it! | D1a = Figs, chicken, and jalapeno. Wheat dough with sauce and cheese. }} {{Order | Wheat Dough + Tomato Sauce + Zucchini | D1 = I'm feelin' wheat dough with zucchini on red sauce! Don't add cheese, but make it dark! | D1a = Yeah, I want to eat zucchini with only tomato sauce on wheat dough. No cheese, but please double-bake it! | N1a = Bake the pizza '''twice'''. }} {{Order | Wheat Dough + (Pesto Sauce + Cheese + Shrimp) + (Zucchini) | D1 = My mother makes amazing zucchini wheat bread. I wonder how yours pairs with shrimp, cheese, and a basil dip? | D1a = Pesto would suffice as a replacement basil dip, so that, cheese, and shrimp on one side. Zucchini flatbread on the other. On wheat. }} {{Order | Wheat Dough + Pesto Sauce + Cheese + Basil + Shrimp + Zucchini | D1 = It has been foretold by the pizza ancients that zucchini goes best with shrimp, herbs, and cheese. But only on green sauce and wheat dough. | D1a = I made that all up. Can I just have zucchini, shrimp, and basil? Add pesto, cheese, and put it on wheat dough. Thanks! }} {{Order | Wheat Dough + Cheese + Eggplant + Sliced Tomato + Zucchini | D1 = Eggplant should never go with zucchini unless they're beside tomatoes and on top of a cheesy wheat flatbread. | D1a = Eggplant, zucchini, and sliced tomatoes on a cheesy flatbread. This is a reference to the plot of the [[Wikipedia:Super Mario Bros.|1985 ''Super Mario Bros.'']] video game. * An order asking for a cheese and zucchini flatbread is a direct reference to the first lyrics of ''Imagine'', by [[Wikipedia:John Lennon|John Lennon]]. * An order says that a customer had a friend named James who had a giant peach, which is a reference to the [[Wikipedia:Roald Dahl|Roald Dahl]] children's novel [[Wikipedia:James and the Giant Peach|''James and the Giant Peach'']]. * A customer orders an Apple Crisp after seeing a painting where a green apple is in front of someone's face, which is [[Wikipedia:The Son of Man|''The Son of Man'']] by [[Wikipedia:René Magritte|René Magritte]]. * One of the orders which asks for Pumpkins talked about a pumpkin turning into a carriage, which is what happened in the fairy tale [[Wikipedia:Cinderella|''Cinderella'']]. * One of the orders which asks for a mushroom pizza, where they say to not top it with animal, vegetable, and mineral references the 1880 Gilbert and Sullivan comic opera ''[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pirates_of_Penzance The Pirates of Penzance]'' * Three orders reference the Nickelodeon cartoon [[Wikipedia:SpongeBob SquarePants|''SpongeBob SquarePants'']]. ** An order asking for a pineapple pizza asks for a topping, which "would make a great house for an underwater sponge." The cartoon's titular character lives in a pineapple under the sea. *** Asking "What?" to this order will have the customer say the first lyric to the show's theme song. ** Another order, asking for seafood toppings and pineapple, also references the first lyric of the show's theme song. ** Another order asking for pizzas with smelly toppings is actually a quote said by Mr. Krabs in the very first episode (''Help Wanted''). *** This order was formerly for an anchovy pizza and when you asked "What?", when this was still the case, the customer will complete the quote, screaming "ANCHOVIES!!!". * The seafood pizza order is a reference to the animated movie [[Wikipedia:Finding Nemo|''Finding Nemo'']]. * One order from [[Little Ovenists Event (2024)]] has someone having a tea party with a space ranger toy and a cowboy toy which are best friends. This is a reference to characters in the movie [[Wikipedia:Toy Story|''Toy Story'']]: Buzz Lightyear and Woody. ** Asking "What?" to this order will have the customer say that they "love hearing their toy stories", likely another reference to the movie. * One of the orders which asks for a shrimp pizza, where they say "there's a million ways to cook it," is a reference to the movie [[Wikipedia:Forrest Gump|''Forrest Gump'']]. * When asking for a vegan pizza a costumer might say "No, I don't have vegan powers... Can I just get a vegan pizza". This is a reference to [https://scottpilgrim.fandom.com/wiki/Veganism veganism] in the comic, movie and TV show [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scott_Pilgrim Scott Pilgrim].
